# Use existing brand material

Your colleague has given you `brand.tokens.json` and `welcome.svg` for Northstar.

Use them in Lolly to make an announcement. Change the headline to **Northstar open day**, use the supplied brand colours, and save a finished file that you could send to someone.

Afterwards, return the app's brand settings to how they were before you brought in the supplied brand. Keep the announcement you made.
